notes.title: An update, some fixes, and a big THANK YOU!
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you![/h2]

First of all, a big THANK YOU to everyone who bought, played, streamed, shared, and reviewed our game this past week. Without your support, our launch wouldn't have been such a success!!! And if you enjoyed Witchy Life Story but haven't had the chance to review it yet, please do! 

[b]Reviews are a great way to keep supporting games like ours! :)[/b]

[h2]Now for the update...[/h2]

We've been seeing some folks asking for an endless mode in Witchy Life Story where you can keep crafting spells after you completed the main game. We're happy to announce we're working on it!

As of now, we're thinking after you finish the main game, a button will appear on the title screen that takes you to the endless mode. Here you can keep crafting spells using recipes from the game, but also new ones based off whatever ingredients you want to use! You'll also be able to access the character creator if you just want to play dress up, along with your altar so you can keep decorating and doing tarots readings. Of course you'll have access to the garden and village shop too when you need to get more spellcrafting supplies!

[h2]Oct. 11th Bug Fixes & Updates [/h2]
[list]
[*] Minor spelling and grammar error
[*] Achievements should all now unlock
[*] Fixed dialog text issue where last few words would get cut off
[*] Fixed *some* of the resolution issues. Text and screens should resize properly, but some stuff needs to be worked out still. See "know issues" below.
[*] Divination Oil should now unlock on the player's altar
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Depending on the resolution, the player's witch doesn't size correctly
[*] Depending on the resolution, the options menu and some other UI elements don't clear correctly when closed.
[*] Depending on the resolution, the mouse cursor duplicates itself in the garden
[/list]

As always, if you find any bugs or issues, let us know! Feel free to post them in the "Bugz" discussion here on steam, or email us at info@sundewstudios.com! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1427340/Witchy_Life_Story/

notes.title: Winter 2022 Dev Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I've got a pretty fun update for you this month! Other than a ton of progress being made on Witchy Life Story, we're going to be part of an exciting event this week.

I've been heads-down this winter writing and polishing the game. It's probably 90% written at this point, but it still needs to be edited and all that stuff. I've also been busy with tasks like making buttons pop. and making sure everything is working the way it's supposed to be working. Basically tying up a bunch of loose ends that makes everything look nice (or nicer, since I'm not quite done yet...).

   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40353871/1a536f2afe9ed133cc7e7dc6c0c96add35275872.gif[/img]

On the art side of things, Sara, WLS's character and background artist, added two more outfits to our character creator. They created a Kiki's Delivery Service-inspired dress, and a flashy shirt and pants set! Lianne, WLS's objects/flower and UI artist, redid the incense and charm spell art for the game to make them more florally. She also completed the enchantment art too... But I'm not going to spoil that here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40353871/d971e1388e7fb3aa81c0474c4365b7536021e716.png[/img]

Now for the fun part...

We're going to show you the first 20 minutes of Witchy Life Story next week here on Steam!!! 

Witchy Life Story is going to be part of [url=https://bit.ly/WomenDayEvent]Wings Fund's Women's Day Steam event[/url] along with 200+ other fantastic games! To celebrate, I'm pre-recording a stream of the first 20 mins of Witchy Life Story, which we'll be showing sometime this week. In the stream, I'll give an in-depth view of a character creator, spell-crafting, and more! I'll also talk a bit about the process of making the game, and what else you have to look for too. Make sure to keep your eyes out on our social media accounts and here on Steam for more details!

Hope to see you there!

Allie, Founder & Creative Director
